scope: Restore retry and engine-abort propagation for the selected required failure actions, preserve reviewed optional policies, protect Storyboard from writing a terminal status after a failed status read, and finish Motion failure notification isolation.

beforeAfter.before: Separate catch/log/return blocks let required cleanup failures checkpoint as successful.
beforeAfter.after: The domain groups dependent reads/writes; runFailureActions attempts remaining independent actions and then throws the first required-action error.

beforeAfter.before: Generic catches or allSettled could treat engine interruptions as terminal child failures.
beforeAfter.after: Engine interruptions escape unchanged, stop later failure actions, and survive the reviewed parent aggregations.

beforeAfter.before: Storyboard could write failed after its current-status read threw.
beforeAfter.after: Read and guarded write share an action, so a failed read skips the write while independent notification is still attempted.

beforeAfter.before: Motion failure persistence could stop before notifying.
beforeAfter.after: Motion attempts its independent notification and propagates required persistence errors; its batch caller preserves the failure for step retry.

preservedOptionalPolicies: LocationSheet, Image, ShotVariant, Music and Lipsync ordinary notification errors remain best effort; engine aborts propagate.
AnalyzeScript/Storyboard ordinary reservation-release errors and Image preview ordinary failure-row write errors retain their existing best-effort behavior.
Recast keeps a direct await for its single required notification rather than adding a wrapper.
originalAssertionTreatment: Existing ownership, payload, primary/variant and successful terminal-state assertions continue to pass. Expectations that a required cleanup failure resolves successfully were changed to assert notification attempt plus rejection. Ordinary notification best-effort cases remain distinct from abort cases.
newEvidence: Nine pure failure-action cases and five real-base composition cases exercise the shared retry/error contract with host-side substitutes.
The selected domain hook regressions cover notification attempts after ordinary persistence failures and immediate abort propagation.
Bible parent regressions cover durable cleanup retry/exhaustion, held:false, guarded child-failure cleanup without duplicate broadcast, and abort propagation.
Motion regression covers lookup/claim/clear/append/write boundaries and its blocked-dialogue batch caller.
The final integrated suite passed 29 files and 477 tests.

tests.claim: Required failure actions preserve retry/error propagation and engine interruptions while retaining the reviewed optional policies; host-side tests do not establish Cloudflare replay or delivery.

quality.typecheck: passed after three callback-narrowing errors were fixed
quality.targetedLint: passed with one unchanged warning outside the diff
quality.documentation: passed: 17 format files, 10 JSON, 43 JSONL records and 160 local links

openItems: The existing markVoiceClaimTerminal updates the version and pending voice pointer separately; failure of the second update may make a retry skip pointer cleanup. This DB helper was not changed.
Storyboard retains its original non-atomic read/terminal-status write and skip-on-terminal notification guard; this batch only closes the failed-read blind write.
Other failure hooks and historical best-effort policies remain subject to separate review.
Real Cloudflare durable replay/restart, Workerd authenticated HTTP, provider, remote D1/R2, browser delivery and wallet settlement remain unvalidated.
GC-03/P3 remain open; all 1219 frozen inventory dispositions remain pending and P4 has not started.
